thread:
Olivia: Quick ops thread 14 Stratus reached out about APAC-SW edge zone capacity. They can provision but need SKU holds + marketplace entitlements before we enable in console. Can we map next steps?
Samir: What SKUs / counts are they requesting? Any SLA asks?
Olivia: Partner sent SKUs: Stratus-NXG-A100-40, Stratus-NXG-A100-80, Stratus-T4-Std. Initial request: 6 x A100-40, 2 x A100-80, 12 x T4 for month 1. They want a marketplace listing and entitlements assigned to our publisher ID.
Priya: Legal flags 14 marketplace entitlements need an addendum and DPA check. Also marketing wants a copy review for the joint announcement. Partner timeline request: announcement target 2026-05-10, legal signoff needed by 2026-04-28.
Ethan: I'll open the quota ticket today. Recommend we request a small buffer and autoscale policy. Also need partner subscription IDs so we can attach entitlement grants.
Olivia: Can Stratus validate SKU availability with this check?
```
cloudcli sku check --region apac-southwest --sku Stratus-NXG-A100-40 --output table
```
Samir: I'll ask them. Partner contact is jess@stratus.example and they said they'd start the entitlement flow. I'll CC legal and Nina (comms).
deploy-bot: Reminder: marketplace entitlements must reference publisher ID + manifest v2.2. See internal checklist: https://internal/docs/marketplace/entitlement-checklist. Automated follow-up in 48h.
Priya: Product gating notes 14 need a canary plan, regression prompt set, and perf targets: p50 < 120ms, p95 < 300ms for gen chat. Define rollback criteria up front.
Ethan: Canary plan 14 spin 1x A100-80 + 1x A100-40 in SE edge and run 24h load + token-cost sims. I'll report latency, token cost, and error rates back here.
Olivia: Ownerships: Samir = partner comms & entitlement coordination; Ethan = quota ticket + canary; Priya = legal & marketplace signoff; Nina = PR copy & timeline; Olivia = overall partner lead and announcement coordination.
Samir: Stratus confirmed they'll submit the entitlement form by 2026-04-15 and want a joint PR draft the week of 2026-04-20.
Ethan: Ticket CLOUD-79055 created: https://cloudprovider/tickets/CLOUD-79055. Quota requested: 10 GPUs (prod + buffer), 1.2k vCPU. Assigned to infra-quotas queue.
Olivia: Good. Nina: can you block time for comms review and an approval matrix?
Nina: Yup 14 will draft PR copy by EOD Fri and route to comms/legal. Will include joint quote placeholders.
Samir: I'll ping Jess for subscription IDs and entitlement confirmation. Tagging partner in DM.
deploy-bot: Note: entitlement forms not completed will block marketplace publication.
Olivia: Thanks all 14 I'll update when partner confirms submission. If quota or entitlement stalls, escalate to partner cloud rep and legal respectively.
Ethan: I'll post canary results here within 48h of spin-up.
Priya: Adding checklist items to rollout doc now (canary playbook, legal addendum template, regression prompts).
Samir: Thanks everyone 14 ping me if you need me to follow up with Stratus directly. :thumbsup:
